title: evergreen-retail-integration-call-notes-2026-02-27
content:
Attendees: Evergreen - Sarah K (Head of AI), Jon P (Platform), Priya R (Security). Redwood - Aisha (SE), Marcus (SRE), Evan (Solutions).

Purpose: scoping integration for in-store recommendations + customer support agent. Focus = low-latency inference (store kiosks), PII handling, model updates cadence.

Notes:
- Data flow: Evergreen will send anonymized session logs -> S3 (us-east-1) -> Redwood hosted API for realtime scoring. They may also want a private deployment later for full PII.
- Auth: OAuth2 client creds for server-to-server. They asked about mTLS for kiosk -> edge. We confirmed we support JWT + optional mTLS on Private.
- Rate/throughput: typical store peak = 120 reqs/min per store. Pilot: 10 stores -> ~1.2k reqs/min peak. Need capacity plan for Dedicated if >100 stores.
- Latency SLO: <120ms P95 for single-turn scoring. We suggested edge routing + small quantized model.
- Models: they prefer an Llama-variant open model. Concerned about cold-starts on kiosks with small mem. Proposed fallback to smaller quantized variant.
- Data residency & PII: initial pilot with anonymized telemetry ok for hosted, but for full customer dataset they require VPC/private deployment + KMS.
- Logging/audit: must retain request logs for 90 days; security team will review. We noted Redwood Console can export traces to their SIEM.

Open questions / Gotchas:
- Q: exact schema of session payload (they said "we'll share" - follow up).
- Q: kiosk network reliability - may need local cache & offline fallback. Need to document fallback UX.
- Gotcha: store-level peaks correlate with POS system batch updates at 15:00 daily (unknown bursts). Recommend capacity buffer.
- Security: Priya R asked about customer-managed KMS + HSM; legal will need SOC2++ docs.

Next steps / ACTIONS:
- Aisha: send template payload + sample curl (by 2026-03-01).
- Marcus: draft capacity estimate + pilot config (Dedicated vs hosted) for 10-store pilot (by 2026-03-04).
- Evan: add notes about offline caching and kiosk fallback UX (by 2026-03-03).
- Evergreen: share sample anonymized session logs + security questionnaire (by 2026-03-02).
- Schedule: pilot kickoff target week of 2026-03-15, 6-week pilot.

Extras / internal notes:
- Consider recommending caching of static recommendations at kiosk to reduce token costs.
- Pilot model candidate: redwood/open-llama-7b-quant (subject to quality eval).
- PR checklist: need JIRA ticket (JIRA-ER-789 exists), attach Confluence onboarding page.

Quick todo (for next sync):
- Confirm payload schema (Aisha)
- Confirm SLA expectations and logging retention (Marcus + Legal)
- Prepare short one-pager for Evergreen execs summarizing risk & timeline (Evan)

Rough risks: data residency escalation -> Private deployment + legal SOW; kiosks offline UX may increase dev work; burst qps may require Dedicated commit sooner than planned.

-- end of notes (scratchpad)
